name: Apple Tree
intro: An apple tree is a fruit tree. It grows apples that we can eat.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: An apple tree has a wide, round top.
Its leaves are oval with a pointy tip.
In spring, it has white or pink flowers.
Each flower has 5 petals.
In fall, apples hang from its branches.

sections.title: Where does it grow?
sentences: Apple trees first grew in Central Asia.
Now people grow them all over the world.
Most grow in the top half of the world.
People grow apple trees on farms and in yards.

sections.title: What does it need?
sentences: An apple tree needs lots of sun.
It likes sun for 8 hours each day.
Its soil must not stay soggy.
It needs a good drink of water each week.
It needs pollen from a different kind of apple tree.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: In winter, the apple tree rests.
In spring, new leaves and flowers grow.
Bees carry pollen from flower to flower.
Then the petals fall, and a tiny apple grows.
In fall, the apples are ripe and ready to pick.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: There are thousands of kinds of apples.
Apple trees are in the rose family.
Inside an apple, the seeds sit in a star shape.
Apples get sweeter just before they are picked.
An apple tree can live 100 years or more.
